title: Gingerbread Spirit
description: A simple festive datapack that adds gingerbread cookies you can craft
body:
This datapack is an extremely simple one, adding Gingerbread Cookies that are picked from an randomized selection of shapes. When eaten, it provides the festive spirit making it snow around the player for 30 seconds.

![Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80003078f0906b85b7e729de41dfd7dd2ba21ece.png)
![Every Gingerbread Cookie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3fae25b7860eb80b0adc1e9fa60b8af005b67aae.png)

This datapack was made in a day on a whim. Hope you enjoy it!
